name: Outdoor Plug S Gen3
description: Smart outdoor Wi-Fi plug with power monitoring (IP44)
measure_description: No separate measurements. This model reuses the values of `shelly/S3PL-00112EU` because Shelly documents both plugs with the same metering hardware and the same electrical ratings: 12 A / 2500 W, 44x44x70 mm, 60 g, ESP-Shelly-C38F with 8 MB flash, internal temperature sensor plus AC voltmeter, AC ammeter and power/energy meters, SPNO relay with 10000 switching cycles. Both knowledge base pages publish the identical `Simplified internal schematics` figure, and the two EU declarations of conformity (No. 224 and No. 244, both dated 2025-12-05) list the same harmonized standards. The only documented differences are the IP44 enclosure, a wider ambient range (-25 to 51 °C instead of -20 to 40 °C) and the device model string (S3PL-20112EU instead of S3PL-00112EU); the metering path is not part of any documented difference. Sources: https://kb.shelly.cloud/knowledge-base/shelly-plug-s-mtr-gen3 and https://kb.shelly.cloud/knowledge-base/outdoor-plug-s-gen3
